messages:
ken_releases: Heads up — SDK 3.5 rollout scheduled for tonight 23:00 PDT. Release notes show a change to model binding behavior (default: strict_bind=true) that can break older runtime adapters. I'm proposing we DO NOT unpin runtime globally yet; instead: pin runtime->v2.14 in APAC region only for 48h while EU/NA run unpinned canaries. Thoughts?

sarah_ops: +1 to regional split. APAC latency/compat historically noisier with longseq models.

maria_swe: Can we patch the SDK to add a backward-compat flag (compat_strict=false) instead? If that lands tonight we might avoid pins.

liam_qa: We ran quick smoke on sdk3.5 with strict_bind=false against runtime v2.14 and saw a 2% decode mismatch on long prompts (sampled). With strict_bind=true failures jumped to 8% and a few timeouts.

anya_prod: If we go regional pin, what's the rollback/rollback-trigger threshold for APAC? We need concrete telemetry conditions to flip the pin.

sam_platform: Propose triggers: error rate increase by >4% sustained 5m OR median tail latency p95 > +250ms over baseline for 10m OR any customer-facing 500s spike. Auto rollback window 30m cooldown.

ken_releases: Those triggers sound good. Also want a manual escape hatch: if deploybot posts a "pin blocked" alert, oncall can escalate and flip global pin.

maria_swe: Pushing tiny patch with compat_strict toggle. If QA signs off before 21:30 PDT we can skip APAC pin. Otherwise we proceed with regional pin plan.

deploybot: [deploybot] initiates canary-precheck for sdk/3.5 at 21:00 PDT — running compatibility matrix across regions.

liam_qa: Running regression harness now. Will post results in 30m. Quick note: observed memory bump ~120MB on a few endpoints under perf load with sdk3.5 strict_bind=false. Not critically high but worth noting.

anya_prod: For APAC pin ops, what exact config will be set? Please paste the pin command.

sam_platform: Command we'll run: `rbctl runtime pin --region apac --runtime-version v2.14 --reason "sdk3.5 compat hold" --ttl 48h`

ken_releases: Also: update release notes: call out that SDK 3.5 changes model binding default and include migration step and compat toggle example. Maria please add.

maria_swe: Will add section: "If you rely on runtime adapters older than v2.15, set compat_strict=false" with a YAML snippet.

liam_qa: QA results: canary NA/EU passed core regressions. APAC canary failed 6/120 fuzz tests with strict_bind=true. With compat_strict=false failures dropped to 1/120. Recommendation: proceed with regional pin unless we merge patch.

maria_swe: Patch merged to main and CI green at 20:55 PDT. Rolling a hotpatch release (3.5.1) with compat_strict defaulting to previous behavior for now.

deploybot: [deploybot] sdk-service release 3.5.1 pushed to npm and pypi at 20:58 PDT. Changelog: revert default strict_bind, add compat toggle env: REDWOOD_SDK_COMPAT_STRICT.

ken_releases: Given 3.5.1 landed, hold off on APAC pin. We'll still monitor APAC closely for 2 hours post-release. If we see any of the triggers, we'll execute `rbctl runtime pin --region apac ...` as planned.

sam_platform: Monitoring windows: start 21:00-23:00 PDT rolling, with 1m scraping cadence for latency and 30s for error counters. Set alert thresholds as discussed.

anya_prod: Who will run the manual pin if triggers fire? Oncall alias or specific person?

sarah_ops: I'll be oncall tonight. Tagging @sarah_ops for manual action. If I'm paged and can't respond, ken_releases will take over.

liam_qa: Postmortem item: add a test to perf harness simulating mixed-model longseq with 3.5 defaults.

maria_swe: I'll follow up with the release note PR and migration snippet.

deploybot: [deploybot] canary telemetry: NA/EU: pass. APAC: baseline error rate +0.4% (within noise). No automatic pin triggered.

ken_releases: Thanks team. Closing this thread — we'll reconvene if alerts fire. TL;DR: SDK 3.5.1 shipped, APAC pin on standby, triggers defined: >4% err (5m), p95 +250ms (10m), or 500s spike. Manual pin owner: sarah_ops.
